# 오늘 어때 (todaydate)

> A daily date-scene game: pick the next moment, collect the endings you reach, and share a result card from the ending screen. No ads and no account required. The core game is free; scene packs and decorations are optional, unlocked with points bought in the app. 12 languages.

## Pages
- [한국어](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/ko/): 오늘의 데이트 장면에서 다음 순간을 고르고, 엔딩을 모아 보세요.
- [English](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/en/): Pick the next moment in a daily date scene, and collect the endings you reach.
- [日本語](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/ja/): 今日のデートの場面で次の瞬間を選び、たどり着いたエンディングを集めましょう。
- [繁體中文](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/zh-hant/): 在每日約會場景中選擇下一步，收集你達成的結局。
- [Español](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/es/): Elige el siguiente momento en una escena de cita diaria y colecciona los finales que alcances.
- [Français](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/fr/): Choisissez la suite dans une scène de rendez-vous du quotidien et collectionnez les fins que vous avez découvertes.
- [Deutsch](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/de/): Wähle im Alltags-Date den nächsten Moment und sammle die Enden, die du erreichst.
- [Português (Brasil)](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/pt-br/): Escolha o próximo momento em uma cena de encontro do dia a dia e colecione os finais que alcançar.
- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/id/): Pilih momen berikutnya dalam adegan kencan sehari-hari dan kumpulkan ending yang kamu capai.
- [ไทย](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/th/): เลือกช่วงเวลาถัดไปในฉากเดทประจำวัน แล้วสะสมตอนจบที่คุณได้พบ
- [Tiếng Việt](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/vi/): Chọn khoảnh khắc tiếp theo trong một cảnh hẹn hò mỗi ngày và sưu tầm những kết thúc bạn tìm được.
- [Türkçe](https://todaydate.ipe.rest/tr/): Günlük bir buluşma sahnesinde bir sonraki anı seç ve ulaştığın sonları biriktir.
